The renewal is still in negotiation, and we have not given Orbitly the 15% discount they asked for [1][2].

- **What Orbitly asked for:** On the November 10 renewal call (for their contract ending December 31, 2026), they requested a 15% discount, EU data residency, and quarterly invoicing [1].
- **What we proposed:** After Maya Cohen approved an 8% discount for a 2-year term (capping Sam Ortiz at 10% without further approval) [3], Sam sent a proposal on November 17 offering an 8% discount on a 2-year term, quarterly invoicing, and stating that EU data residency is on the 2027 roadmap [2].
- **Current status:** Jonas Pike replied on November 17 that 8% is below what they discussed internally and said they would review with procurement [2]. A follow-up call is scheduled for Tuesday, November 24 [2].
- **Open item:** Orbitly is also claiming an SLA service credit for the November 12 dashboard delay incident as part of the renewal conversation, and Sam is checking their 2024 MSA terms [3][4].
